sources.title: A Comprehensive Survey on Deep Learning Multi-Modal Fusion: Methods ...
sources.snippet: Unimodal tasks only use a single data type as the model's input, while multi-modal tasks use two or more modal data as the input. The success of multi-modal fusion technology in the above fields depends on the inherent properties of different modal data and the high correlation and complementarity between them.
